question: In which country, is the Five-Hundred-Metre Aperture Spherical Telescope (FAST) for listening to alien life opened in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Dawodang depression, **a natural basin in Pingtang County, Guizhou, southwest China, is home to the** Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Radio Telescope.**
 
• FAST is built in a natural dip in the environment with a 500 m (1,600 ft) diameter dish.
 
• After Russia's sparsely-filled RATAN-600, it is the world's largest filled-aperture radio telescope and the second-largest single-dish aperture.
 
• It helps scientists in detecting more distant and fainter objects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• It features a unique design, with an active surface made up of 4,500 panels that move in real-time to form a moving parabola of metal panels.
 
• The feed antenna cabin, suspended on cables above the dish, may move automatically by steering the instrument with winches to receive signals from various directions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **China:** 

 
 
• 
 Capital: Beijing
 
 
• 
 Largest city: Shanghai
 
 
• 
 President: Xi Jinping
